title: DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents
title_zh: DMC-5：面向长程智能体的缓存感知上下文压缩与双模型协作
abstract_en: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an Append-only Canonical View, preserving global access while allowing the compressor to reuse a stable historical prefix instead of recursively rewriting or recomputing prior context. The agent operates only on a compact Decision View with recent raw interactions, reducing repeated input while retaining the information needed for the next action. DMC-5 further incorporates YAMATO (integritY-Aware Memory Abstractions for Tool Operations) to preserve execution-critical information during lossy compression. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.
abstract_zh: 长程智能体需要反复向专用模型输入不断增长的交互轨迹。前缀缓存虽能复用历史计算，却无法限制上下文增长，也无法剔除与当前决策无关的信息。当专用模型不像通用模型那样享有缓存输入折扣时，压缩轨迹尤为重要。然而，选择性压缩可能丢失全局信息，递归改写摘要容易造成语义漂移，反复压缩完整历史则会把不断增长的开销转移给压缩模型。为此，DMC-5 采用非对称双模型协作：通用模型负责整合完整历史，专用模型负责生成动作。框架将原始轨迹保存在仅追加的规范视图（Append-only Canonical View）中，使压缩模型既能访问完整历史，又能复用稳定的历史前缀。专用模型只读取紧凑的决策视图（Decision View），其中保留近期原始交互和下一步行动所需的信息。DMC-5 还引入 YAMATO，在有损压缩中保留工具执行所需的关键信息。在 AppWorld、OfficeBench 和 8-objective QA 上，相比不压缩的基线，DMC-5 将专用模型的输入量降低 38.5%–57.0%，端到端成本降低 14.5%–28.0%，任务表现提升 1.0%–5.8%；压缩模型的缓存命中率为 78.0%–85.0%。
key_points_zh: DMC-5 将历史整合与动作生成分开：通用模型负责压缩，专用智能体模型负责决策。
Append-only Canonical View 保留完整原始轨迹，通过稳定前缀复用缓存，避免递归改写摘要或反复重算历史。
Decision View 只向专用模型提供紧凑的决策上下文和近期原始交互；YAMATO 在有损压缩中保留工具执行关键信息。
三项评测中，专用模型输入量减少 38.5%–57.0%，端到端成本降低 14.5%–28.0%，任务表现较不压缩基线提升 1.0%–5.8%。

agent-memory.reason: 核心贡献是保存软件智能体的原始交互轨迹，并将其压缩为包含近期原始交互的决策视图，供后续行动使用，而非仅复用计算缓存。相对未压缩基线，实验报告了输入和成本下降、任务表现提升，但摘要未提供消融来区分各组件的作用。
